title: Firefly Learning Bridge Result v1
description: ONE-SHOT output of a single headless learning task, written by the firefly-learning skill to <course>/bridge/result.json. It is a delivery envelope, NOT learning state: mastery/progress/quiz authority stays in teach-mcp. Any progress figure shown here is a display snapshot and must carry source=teach-mcp.

task_id.description: Echo of the task_id Firefly assigned to this run (from Learning Context).

display_text.description: Agent-finalized teaching text. Firefly displays it verbatim; the ordinary chat LLM must NOT rewrite it.

question.description: Present when message_type=question. Values come verbatim from teach-mcp generate_question; never invented.

opaque_refs.description: teach-mcp-returned identifiers echoed verbatim (session_id today). Never invented, never treated as state.

progress_snapshot.description: OPTIONAL display-only snapshot. Must carry source=teach-mcp; consumers must not persist it as state.
